description: A multimodal dataset of 14,938 teacher-emotion instances from classroom-related text, audio, video, and instructional contexts, created by Zhiyi Duan et al.
title: T-MED: the first large-scale multimodal teacher sentiment analysis dataset

description: An automated computer-based assessment tool developed by Lehmann et al.
title: T-MITOCAR (Text-Model Inspection Trace of Concepts and Relations)

title: T-NOTECHS

description: A paired teacher-and-student questionnaire instrument developed by Avivit Arvatz and colleagues to assess self-regulated-learning subprocesses and reflection through self-report and triangulated open-ended responses.
title: T-SQsrl paired teacher and student SRL questionnaires
